title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule (Subject to Change)
summary: The public presentation schedules for Fall 2026 master's thesis examinations and doctoral preliminary examinations are provided in two attached files, which were not read for this translation. Because times and locations may change at any time, all attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course, must check the attached schedule again on the day of the examination. Questions should be directed to the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
applies_to: All attendees of the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination and doctoral preliminary examination public presentations, including (but not limited to) students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course. Checking the attached schedule on the day of the examination is mandatory.

dates.what: Final check of the attached schedule for any changes to time or location (all attendees, including Master's/Doctoral Seminar students)
dates.when: On the day of the examination

conditions: The specific presentation dates, times and locations are given only in the attached files, which were not read for this translation.
The schedule may be changed or updated at any time without separate notice.
Times and locations may change, so attendees must check the attached schedule again on the day of the examination.
steps: Open the original notice and read the attached files: '2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf' (master's examination schedule) and '2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf' (doctoral preliminary examination schedule).
On the day of the examination, check the attached schedule again for any changes to the time or location before attending.
For questions, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Subject to change) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the public presentation schedule for Fall 2026 master's and doctoral thesis examinations.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- See the attached file (the content may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary examination [초심]) schedule
- See the attached file (the content may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated from time to time. Since times, locations, etc. may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course [석박사세미나], must check the attached file again on the day of the examination.

4. Inquiries
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person, phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2)
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary examination schedule, 151 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 master's examination schedule, 268 KB)

[Note: The contents of the attached files were not available and were not read for this translation.]
